name: How long does window installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window installation project depends on the number of windows, their size, the type of installation (e.g., full-frame replacement versus insert), and any unexpected structural issues. Typically, a professional team can install 10-15 windows in one to three days. Larger projects with more complex window types or extensive frame repairs will naturally take longer. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window installation usually takes one to three days for 10-15 windows, depending on the number, size, and complexity of the project.
